skill.name: AgentOps Session Initialization
skill.description: Initialize AgentOps monitoring with automatic or manual session creation, associating all subsequent events and API calls with a tracking session.
skill.skill_body:
Call agentops.init() with your API key to establish a monitoring session. By default, a session starts automatically and all events are associated with it. For manual control, pass auto_start_session=False and later call agentops.start_session() with optional tags when ready to begin tracking.

## Objective

establish_monitoring_session
## Applicable Signals

- Application startup phase
- Agent initialization
- Workflow session start

## Contraindications

- Session management is handled by an external framework
- Monitoring is not required for the application
- AgentOps is not installed or API key is unavailable

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Call agentops.init(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY") to initialize with automatic session creation', 'condition': 'Use when automatic session start is acceptable'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Alternatively, call agentops.init(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY", auto_start_session=False) to defer session start', 'condition': 'Use when session timing must be controlled manually'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'If manual mode, call agentops.start_session(tags=[...]) at the appropriate time to activate tracking', 'condition': 'Required only if auto_start_session=False was set'}

## Constraints

- Valid API key must be provided to agentops.init()
- If auto_start_session=False, agentops.start_session() must be called explicitly before event capture begins
- Session initialization must occur before any agent or API calls that should be tracked

## Cautions

- Ensure API key is kept secure and not hardcoded in production
- Manual session start requires explicit invocation; automatic mode is default

## Output Contract

- Active AgentOps session with API key authenticated and ready to capture events. Session ID or tags assigned if manual start is used. All subsequent API calls and events are associated with this session until it is closed.
